userCorrection.instruction: Each preset must use a three-dimensional finished-garment thumbnail; a simple dedicated plastic display mannequin is allowed; paper pieces are not visually sufficient.
allowed: static images rendered from real preset-specific 3D garment geometry
a simple dedicated plastic display mannequin instead of a real human
forbiddenSubstitutions: one garment renamed as multiple presets

historicalObservation.currentPublicStatement: Thumbnails come from real paper patterns, not garment photos.

mustNeverRepeat: Treat a successful test of the superseded paper-thumbnail contract as proof of the later 3D-garment-thumbnail correction.
Count paper SVGs, diagrams, or unrelated images as preset-specific 3D garment thumbnails.
Claim collection completion from a subset without 60-member coverage and identity receipts.
Promote thumbnail evidence into physical-fit, collision, dynamic-wear, device, or user acceptance.
gate: Preserve the old paper-library success as a scoped historical observation; do not relabel it as failure.
A run predating the correction or testing only paper thumbnails cannot satisfy the corrected contract.
All 60 expected preset IDs must have member-level 3D derivation receipts and public card readback.
The thumbnail may be a static render, but it must derive from actual preset-specific 3D garment geometry on the declared simple mannequin.
Passing this case does not certify cloth physics, fit, collision, dynamic wear, physical device behavior, or user acceptance.

activation.rollbackPoint: Keep current P01 paper preset library as BASELINE_ONLY_PRE_CORRECTION until a separate corrected candidate passes; do not overwrite the old evidence.
